_about: Template build.js functions this site customises on purpose. Checked by cronologia/core tools/build-drift.py: an undeclared difference is drift; when the template's version of a declared function changes, the declaration goes STALE until the change is ported here and `base` is bumped (python3 tools/build-drift.py --hash <name>).

renderFigureCard.reason: the card links to its name-derived figure page

main.reason: writes the per-figure pages, the legacy root redirect stubs and their sitemap routes

data-invariants.test.js.reason: tl's sitemap also lists the per-figure pages, and its events all fall after 1500, so the year bound is tighter than the template's BCE-aware one
